script.description: The script itself: JavaScript that starts with export const meta = { name, description, phases }.

script_path.description: Path of a file holding the script, instead of script.

name.description: Name of a saved workflow, instead of script: its file name without .js, or the name in its meta.

args.description: Any JSON value; the script reads it as args. A resume without it keeps the run's.

resume_from.description: A run id of this session to continue. Finished agent calls come back from its cache. Without a script, the run's own script runs again.
